Personality: Bericor is a classic pleasure-loving Vlandian lord of gentle and generous temperament. Rather than charging into battle, he much prefers spending gold like water at feasts to maintain his clan's dignity and win the goodwill of others. In military decisions, however, he appears overly timid, always shying away from direct conflict—an extreme caution often viewed by his peers as a lack of courage. Ill-suited to deep strategic foresight, his conduct carries a touch of whimsy and impulse, inclining him to resolve immediate troubles with coin and smooth words. Though lacking the stern majesty of a commander, his approachable charm and keen nose for wealth allow him to handle estate administration and commercial dealings with ease. A nobleman who values tangible profit over chivalric honor, he exhibits a pragmatic if short-sighted approach to state affairs.
Background: As the head of the dey Lothad clan, Bericor holds court at Usanc Castle and serves King Derthert of Vlandia. In a kingdom founded by Osric Iron-Arm that prizes martial prowess and feudal contracts, Bericor's house belongs to the noble Peerage, yet he himself has not inherited the pioneering, warlike spirit of his forebears. Acutely aware of the complex political landscape of Vlandia, where barons carve out their own domains and vie with royal authority, he has chosen trade and diplomacy as the foundation of his clan's survival. He carefully manages the estates of Usanc Castle, accumulating substantial wealth through commercial enterprises rather than wartime plunder. While raising his children Elandara and Daganic, he constantly walks a cautious tightrope between answering King Derthert's summons and preserving his clan's strength. Representing the moderate and conservative side of the Vlandian nobility, he seeks to pave a secure path of survival for his family across the turbulent continent of Calradia through gold and compromise.
